title: AAPS crashes when applying the setting
body:
I have the following error since the last DEV F version: If I go to settings, AAPS is terminated immediately. All other functions are still applicable. In addition, since the penultimate version, the Eop2 has been beeping when I make a profile change. Attach to the last LOG.
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1673011924856.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/10360491/AndroidAPS_LOG_1673011924856.log.zip)
